Inside was a single sheet, folded twice, the ink feathered where salt had reached it. A woman had written to her brother about a boat that never came back, and asked whoever read this to say his name aloud once. The keeper carried the paper up the ninety-two steps, lit the lamp, and waited until the beam swung out over the water. He logged the twentieth before dawn.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台调低了音量的机器。路灯还亮着，光圈里飘着薄薄的水雾，柏油路面泛出湿冷的青色。环卫车慢慢驶过，刷子摩擦地面的声音在空巷里拖得很长。早点铺拉开半扇卷帘门，蒸笼的白气涌到街上，很快散了。写字楼只剩零星几格窗户还亮，像没睡的眼睛。出租车停在路口，司机把座椅放平，收音机低声念着天气。天边先是灰，再是一点很淡的青白，鸟叫忽然多起来。再过一小时，车流、人声、红绿灯都会回来，而此刻的城市只属于那些还没睡和已经起来的人。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller copy of itself to do most of the work.\n- Example: to count stairs, stand on one step and say \"1 plus however many steps are left above me\" until there are none left.\n- You always need a stopping point (no steps left), or it keeps asking forever and never finishes."}
